licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge (in two page ranges, pp. 247–249 and 250–252), a separate sweep for dynamics and other marks, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (one error found and corrected: in bars 107–108 the words “con-dan-na a mo-rir” were one note late); the marks sweep also removed staccatos in the piano in bars 38, 40 and 57 that are not printed. The German singing translation is left out. Bar 1 is the half-bar upbeat, set as 2/4; then ¢ (alla breve), Allegretto, and Allegro from bar 101. The cut Peters marks from “vi-” (bar 58) to “-de” (bar 93) is not made: the whole aria is here. Playback tempo: Allegretto ♩ = 126 (a half note = 63), Allegro ♩ = 160 (a half note = 80), fitted to Jacobs (4:00); Mozart gives the words only.
